en: Therīgāthā 11.1: The Verses of the Elder Nun Uppalavaṇṇā, from the Section of Twelve I am one who has crossed over the flood; I have reached the further shore. Having seen the peril in existence, I have attained peace. I am now free from all bonds; I have transcended all attachments. I have reached the state of peace; I am cooled and extinguished. I have cut off the stream of craving; I have severed the fetters. I have destroyed the conceit "I am"; I am liberated from all ties. I have reached the goal of my journey; I have done what was to be done. I have laid down the heavy burden; I am free from the weight of existence. I have realized the truth; I have attained the supreme security. I have reached the unshakable state; I am established in the deathless. I have attained the noble fruit; I am a true daughter of the Buddha. I have reached the end of suffering; I am no longer subject to rebirth. I have crossed over the ocean of saṃsāra; I have reached the dry land of nibbāna. I have attained the state of an arahant; I am worthy of offerings. I have reached the final liberation; I shall not be born again. I have realized the Dhamma; I am a true follower of the Teacher. I have reached the goal of the holy life; I am a true disciple of the Buddha. I have attained the state of peace; I am cooled and extinguished. I have reached the end of the path; I am established in the fruit. I have crossed over the mire of defilements; I have reached the further shore. I have attained the state of purity; I am free from all stains. I have reached the state of wisdom; I am endowed with true knowledge. I have attained the state of liberation; I am released from all bonds. I have reached the state of bliss; I am established in the highest happiness. I have attained the state of coolness; I am cooled by the nectar of Dhamma. I have reached the state of safety; I am secure from all dangers. I have attained the state of refuge; I am the shelter for all beings. I have reached the state of sanctuary; I am the island amidst the floods. I have attained the state of light; I am illuminated by the radiance of Dhamma. I have reached the state of vision; I see clearly with the eye of wisdom. I have attained the state of peace; I am at rest in the city of nibbāna. I have reached the state of victory; I have conquered the army of Māra. I have attained the state of sovereignty; I am the ruler of the Dhamma realm. I have reached the state of mastery; I am the master of my own mind. I have attained the state of freedom; I am liberated from all constraints. I have reached the state of excellence; I am the most excellent among women. I have attained the state of greatness; I am great in virtue and wisdom. I have reached the state of nobility; I am noble in my conduct and heart. I have attained the state of purity; I am pure in body, speech, and mind. I have reached the state of holiness; I am a true vessel of the Dhamma. I have attained the state of perfection; I have fulfilled the training. I have reached the state of completion; I have accomplished the task. I have attained the state of fulfillment; I have reached the goal. I have reached the state of attainment; I have realized the fruit. I have attained the state of realization; I have known the truth. I have reached the state of awakening; I am awakened to the Dhamma. I have attained the state of enlightenment; I am enlightened in the three knowledges. I have reached the state of omniscience; I am wise in all things. I have attained the state of all-knowing; I am the knower of all paths. I have reached the state of all-seeing; I see all with the divine eye. I have attained the state of all-hearing; I hear all with the divine ear. I have reached the state of all-perceiving; I perceive all with the mind-made body. I have attained the state of all-pervading; I pervade all with loving-kindness. I have reached the state of all-embracing; I embrace all with compassion. I have attained the state of all-sustaining; I sustain all with sympathetic joy. I have reached the state of all-equanimous; I remain equanimous toward all. I have attained the state of all-beneficent; I benefit all without partiality. I have reached the state of all-honored; I am honored by gods and men. I have attained the state of all-respected; I am respected by the world. I have reached the state of all-loved; I am loved by all beings. I have attained the state of all-beloved; I am beloved by the virtuous. I have reached the state of all-praised; I am praised by the noble ones. I have attained the state of all-celebrated; I am celebrated throughout the world. I have reached the state of all-famed; I am renowned for my virtues. I have attained the state of all-known; I am known as a true arahant. I have reached the state of all-acclaimed; I am acclaimed as a true disciple. I have attained the state of all-admired; I am admired for my spiritual power. I have reached the state of all-envious; I am envied by those still bound. I have attained the state of all-enviable; I am envied by the wise. I have reached the state of all-desirable; I am desired by the seekers of peace. I have attained the state of all-longed-for; I am longed for by those seeking liberation. I have reached the state of all-craved; I am craved by those seeking the Dhamma. I have attained the state of all-coveted; I am coveted by the virtuous. I have reached the state of all-wished-for; I am wished for by the noble ones. I have attained the state of all-hoped-for; I am hoped for by the faithful. I have reached the state of all-expected; I am expected by the world. I have attained the state of all-anticipated; I am anticipated by the seekers. I have reached the state of all-foreseen; I am foreseen by the Buddhas. I have attained the state of all-prophesied; I am prophesied as a future Buddha. I have reached the state of all-ordained; I am ordained in the true Dhamma-Vinaya. I have attained the state of all-consecrated; I am consecrated by the Triple Gem. I have reached the state of all-anointed; I am anointed with the perfume of virtue. I have attained the state of all-adorned; I am adorned with the ornaments of Dhamma. I have reached the state of all-decorated; I am decorated with the marks of a sage. I have attained the state of all-graced; I am graced by the grace of the Buddha. I have reached the state of all-favored; I am favored by the favor of the Dhamma. I have attained the state of all-supported; I am supported by the Sangha. I have reached the state of all-nourished; I am nourished by the food of Dhamma. I have attained the state of all-satisfied; I am satisfied with the taste of liberation. I have reached the state of all-contented; I am contented in the heart of peace. I have attained the state of all-pleased; I am pleased with the joy of nibbāna. I have reached the state of all-delighted; I am delighted by the delight of the Dhamma. I have attained the state of all-rejoiced; I am rejoiced in the rapture of the Path. I have reached the state of all-glad; I am glad in the gladness of the Fruit. I have attained the state of all-blissful; I am blissful in the bliss of the Deathless. I have reached the state of all-happy; I am happy in the happiness of the Unconditioned. I have attained the state of all-joyful; I am joyful in the joy of the Awakened One. I have reached the state of all-peaceful; I am peaceful in the peace of the Sage. I have attained the state of all-cooled; I am cooled by the cooling of the fires. I have reached the state of all-quenched; I am quenched by the quenching of the thirst. I have attained the state of all-calm; I am calm in the calm of the mind. I have reached the state of all-still; I am still in the stillness of the heart. I have attained the state of all-tranquil; I am tranquil in the tranquility of the self. I have reached the state of all-serene; I am serene
“Both mother and daughter were formerly co-wives; at that,
a sense of spiritual urgency arose within me.”
It is wonderful and hair-raising!
Fie on sensual pleasures, which are impure,
foul-smelling, and full of thorns!
Where mother and daughter were both my wives;
having seen the peril in sensual pleasures, [I renounced them].
Seeing renunciation as safety,
she went forth from the home life into homelessness in Rājagaha.
I know my former births,
the divine eye is purified,
and I possess the knowledge of penetrating the minds of others.
The ear-element has been purified.
Psychic powers have been realized by me,
and the destruction of the taints has been attained.
The six direct knowledges have been realized;
the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Having manifested through supernormal power,
Having paid homage at the feet of the Buddha, the Tathāgata,
the Lord of the World, I [mounted] the four-horsed chariot.
“Having approached a tree with blossoms at its peak,
you stand alone at the foot of a sal tree;
nor indeed is there anyone else as your companion.”
“O girl, are you not afraid of rogues?
“Even if hundreds of thousands of such rogues were to assemble together;”
The hair does not stir, nor does it tremble;
what will you do to me alone, O Māra?
Here I vanish.
Or I shall enter your womb;
I shall stand between your eyebrows,
yet you will not see me standing there.
I have attained mastery over my mind,
the bases of psychic power are well-developed,
and the six direct knowledges have been realized.
Thus was the teaching of the Buddha spoken:
"Sensual pleasures are like spears and spikes,
a constant hacking at the aggregates."
That which you call "delight in sensual pleasures" is now for me "disgust.
Delight has been destroyed everywhere.
The mass of darkness has been shattered;
know this, O Evil One:
you are defeated, O Ender!
… The Elder Nun Uppalavaṇṇā … The Twelfth Chapter is concluded.
